reviews.text: Fetch! has taken care of my cats and rabbits for over 5 years. Every pet sitter has been wonderful-reliable and kind. The management has always been responsive to my needs, going above and beyond to make sure my pets are well taken care of. I cannot recommend them highly enough.

My wife and I have used Fetch for both dog walking and cat sitting services for the past 10 years.  When we first added furry members to our family, we tried another service first (with not a great experience) before finding Fetch and being with them ever since.  The scheduling app is easy to use and the team is VERY responsive.  More importantly, they have always been there for us when we needed them.
My cat sitter, Stephanie, is great! She has been taking care of my cat for years and I always know she is in good hands while I'm gone from home.

My husband and I were going out of town and my son who usually takes care of our cat, was unable to.  After doing some research, I sent an email to Fetch! Pet Care.  I received a quick response.  The process to sign up was easy. I met Sara who was going to my cat's caretaker.  Receiving daily pictures and a pet journal put our minds at ease that our cat was being well taken care of.
We're so glad you have a 5-star experience, thank you for using Fetch! Pet Care and trusting us with your pets.

The app is easy to use. They are quick to respond to service requests. We consistently get the same pet sitter or they make efforts to find a good replacement. The sitters are incredibly reliable and responsive. It’s a leap of faith to hire a pet sitter; Fetch makes it easy to trust them.
I had a great experience with Fetch! Veronica was extremely kind and took great care of my two cats. Communication worked very well through the app. I would happily have Veronica watch my cats again.

Fetch has provided intermediate care for my rabbits since 2022. Scheduling is simple and the pet sitters are reliable, down to earth, and trustworthy people. They come to my home to discuss pet care in advance and when I am away they share photos in real time so I can see that my rabbits are happy and healthy. Rabbits are especially difficult to care for because they have specialized needs but I feel comfortable with fetch associates caring for my bunnies when i have to leave home.
I loved the opportunity to do a meet-and-greet before starting service, it made sure my doggo felt comfortable with the walker. Their team is super sweet and communicative. Highly recommend!

Honestly, had been pretty polite, but when I needed something beyond the anctual appointment, I was led in circles. Nothing against the physical, just a sour taste afterwards with their customer service

This reviewer has a personal relationship with a competing business, has never purchased or received services from our company, and the review therefore does not represent a genuine customer experience.
Thanks so much Rebecca, I'm glad you had a 5-star experience with us!

I have used Fetch for many years. They are an amazing company. They have provided excellent service for me every single time. The sitters are responsive and extremely diligent. I have had special needs for my animals and they have ensured that they received the care required. I cannot recommend them enough.

Jonny was outstanding But in reality better than outstanding. Donna, the manager of Fetch is wonderful! My son unexpectedly went in the hospital while I was visiting. I was experiencing so much stress, I'm a senior and can't walk the dog. Donna, found a walker for me within an hour. You are a life safer. Jonny, I thank you from the bottom of my heart for taking great care for my son's dog. 💙

We absolutely love Emma Frieson! She is incredible with our German Shepherd. She shows so much love for him, clearly cares so much about him and our family, and is very diligent at following through with everything we have asked her to do. (She is our weekly walker and has watched him overnight before at our house.) We currently have a substitute walker, Martina Brockway, while Emma is out of town, and we love her as well! I echo all of the comments about Emma for her. Lastly, Robyn O’Neil has been extremely helpful in coordinating services. We love Fetch!!!!
Thanks so much Christopher, thank you for entrusting us with the care of your pet.
Love these guys! The sitters are always prompt and professional, and the prices are fair. Zero complaints.

Fetch! is an outstanding company. They are truly responsive and quick to find you solutions in a pinch. The system they use is top notch with good pictures and feedback from dog services. All the help they have enlisted for us has also been …
I've used this service for years. They are always reliable and communicative. Highly recommended.

Five stars all the way! The team here is amazing.  My energetic pup, Luna, gets the exercise she needs, and I get a detailed journal after every walk. It's like having a personal pet caretaker. Amazing service.
